claim_tested: A locally runnable shared-memory provider should replace the current tools-only Honcho path only if it is available and materially improves representative recall without duplicating transcript, repository, skill, or Kanban authority.

privacy.stored_evidence: counts, readiness state, retrieval verdicts, and public-safe source references only

representative_retrieval.verdict: Honcho is operational but does not replace transcript-grounded session_search for recent exact facts. Keep it as an on-demand semantic/profile supplement only.

hindsight_candidate.verdict: Inconclusive candidate, not an admitted winner. Installing or configuring a new backend solely to create a comparison would mutate the live capability surface before baseline evidence justifies it.

host_disposition.hermes: retain session_search for raw transcript evidence, built-in compact memory for current explicit facts, and Honcho in tools-only mode for semantic/profile recall
host_disposition.codex: defer; live MCP inventory has no Honcho or Hindsight server and Codex runtime session state remains native
host_disposition.omp: defer; native memory backend is off, although the runtime supports Hindsight, local summaries, and Mnemopi

authority_boundaries.durable_facts_preferences_decisions: compact explicit memory plus the admitted semantic provider, currently tools-only Honcho

rollback: No live provider or host configuration changed. Remove this evidence record and decision document to roll back the documentation-only result.
reopen_when: A local Hindsight endpoint and isolated test bank are available without changing the live provider.
The same provenance-scoped suite can run against both providers with equivalent source data.
A candidate materially beats session_search plus tools-only Honcho on representative and held-out cases without broad per-turn injection or duplicate authority.
